pt.R: É do tempo em que o profeta Natã foi falar com Davi, depois que Davi tinha dormido com Bate-Seba.

decisions.choice: The title is verses 1-2
decisions.reason: The Hebrew counts this psalm's long title as two verses, so the verse numbers here are two higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: Nathan and Bathsheba: 2 Samuel 11-12
decisions.reason: David took Bathsheba, the wife of Uriah, and had Uriah killed in battle to hide her pregnancy (2 Samuel 11). The prophet Nathan confronted him with a parable, and David said, "I have sinned against the LORD" (2 Samuel 12:1-13).

decisions.choice: gone in to: had sexual relations with
decisions.reason: To "go in to" a woman is the usual Hebrew way of speaking of sexual union (Genesis 38:16). The title uses the same verb twice: Nathan came to David just as David had come to Bathsheba.

decisions.choice: slept with
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say plainly what the idiom means (m3).

decisions.choice: David ... David
decisions.reason: Readable names David where the Hebrew says "him" and "he", and starts a new sentence, since the title of verse 1 ends there.

decisions.choice: the title's narrative in the passé simple at Literal and Balanced, the passé composé at Readable
alternatives: the passé composé at every level
decisions.reason: The title tells a past event as written narrative, so French follows its usual narrative tenses by level. Balanced says plainly what the idiom "aller vers" means (meaning decision m3) and names David, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "ông" for David in the title
decisions.reason: The title tells a story about David in the third person; "ông" is the respectful narrative pronoun for a grown man, used for David in prose.

decisions.choice: "예언자 나단" and "밧세바"
decisions.reason: Names take their published Protestant form; "예언자" is preferred over the older "선지자" (style guide, Settled).

decisions.choice: veio a ele ... tinha vindo a Bate-Seba
alternatives: depois que ele tinha se deitado com Bate-Seba
decisions.reason: The title uses the same verb twice (m3): Nathan came to David as David had come to Bathsheba. Literal keeps one verb, "vir a", for both, the phrase the Portuguese of 2 Samuel 12:24 uses at Literal for this idiom; Balanced and Readable say "dormido com", as the English says "slept with". The names are the forms of 2 Samuel 11-12, "Natã" and "Bate-Seba".

source.text: חָנֵּ֣נִי אֱלֹהִ֣ים כְּחַסְדֶּ֑ךָ כְּרֹ֥ב רַ֝חֲמֶ֗יךָ מְחֵ֣ה פְשָׁעָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Be gracious to me, God, according to your loyal love; according to [the] abundance of your compassions wipe out my transgressions.

en.L: Be gracious to me, God, according to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love; \q according to the abundance of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} compassion, \q wipe out my transgressions.
en.B: God, be gracious to me in keeping with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love; \q in the fullness of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} compassion, \q wipe away my rebellious acts.
en.R: God, be kind to me, because {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love never ends. \q {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} heart is full of tender mercy, \q so wipe out the record of how I rebelled against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Fais-moi grâce, Dieu, selon {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal ; \q selon l’abondance de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} tendresse, \q efface mes transgressions.
fr.B: Dieu, sois bienveillant envers moi, à la mesure de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle ; \q dans la plénitude de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} tendresse, \q efface mes actes de révolte.
fr.R: Dieu, sois bon pour moi, car {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle ne finit jamais. \q Ton cœur est plein de tendresse, \q alors efface la liste de mes révoltes contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Unifanyie neema, Ee Mungu, kwa kadiri ya upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma; \q kwa kadiri ya wingi wa huruma {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, \q uyafute maasi yangu.
sw.B: Ee Mungu, nifanyie neema kulingana na upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma; \q kwa ukuu wa huruma {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, \q futa matendo yangu ya uasi.
sw.R: Ee Mungu, unihurumie, kwa sababu upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} hauishi kamwe. \q Moyo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} umejaa huruma nyororo, \q basi futa kumbukumbu ya jinsi nilivyokuasi.

es.L: Sé bondadoso conmigo, oh Dios, según {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal; \q según la abundancia de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} compasión, \q borra mis transgresiones.
es.B: Dios, sé bondadoso conmigo, como corresponde a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel; \q en la plenitud de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} compasión, \q borra mis actos de rebeldía.
es.R: Dios, sé bueno conmigo, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel nunca se acaba. \q Tu corazón está lleno de tierna compasión; \q por eso, borra el registro de cómo me rebelé contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

vi.L: Xin làm ơn cho tôi, lạy Đức Chúa Trời, theo tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q theo lòng thương xót dồi dào của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q xin xóa bỏ các sự vi phạm của tôi.
vi.B: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin rủ lòng thương tôi theo tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q theo lòng trắc ẩn lớn lao của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q xin xóa sạch những hành vi phản nghịch của tôi.
vi.R: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin tử tế với tôi, vì tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không bao giờ chấm dứt. \q Lòng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đầy thương xót dịu dàng, \q vậy xin xóa đi những gì ghi lại việc tôi đã chống nghịch {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 하나님, 주님의 한결같은 사랑을 따라 저에게 은혜를 베풀어 주십시오. \q 주님의 크신 긍휼을 따라 \q 제 반역들을 지워 주십시오.
ko.B: 하나님, 주님의 한결같은 사랑에 따라 저에게 은혜를 베푸십시오. \q 넘치는 주님의 긍휼로 \q 제가 거역한 일들을 씻어 없애 주십시오.
ko.R: 하나님, 주님의 변함없는 사랑은 끝이 없으니, 저에게 친절을 베풀어 주십시오. \q 주님의 마음은 따뜻한 자비로 가득하니, \q 제가 주님을 거역한 기록을 지워 주십시오.

pt.L: Mostra-me favor, ó Deus, conforme o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal; \q conforme a abundância da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} compaixão, \q risca as minhas transgressões.
pt.B: Ó Deus, sê bondoso comigo, segundo o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal; \q na plenitude da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} compaixão, \q apaga os meus atos de rebeldia.
pt.R: Ó Deus, sê bondoso comigo, porque o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor fiel nunca acaba. \q O {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} coração é cheio de terna misericórdia; \q por isso apaga o registro de como eu me rebelei contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

decisions.choice: loyal love: chesed
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith within a bond, God's commitment to his people (5:8). David appeals to it, not to anything in himself.

decisions.choice: compassion: tender, motherly mercy
decisions.reason: The word (rachamim, plural) is related to the word for the womb: the deep, tender love of a parent for a child (103:13).

decisions.choice: wipe out: erase, as from a written record
decisions.reason: The verb (machah) is used of wiping a name out of a book (Exodus 32:32-33) and of wiping a dish clean (2 Kings 21:13). The same request comes back in verse 11.

decisions.choice: transgressions: acts of rebellion
decisions.reason: Verses 3-4 use three words for wrongdoing, as 32:1-2 does: transgression (pesha'), rebellion against God's rule; iniquity ('awon), crookedness and the guilt it brings; and sin (chatta't), missing the mark.

decisions.choice: rebellious acts
decisions.reason: Balanced uses a plain word for the meaning of pesha' (m4).

decisions.choice: Your heart is full of tender mercy; wipe out the record
alternatives: according to your great compassion, wipe out
decisions.reason: Readable makes "according to" a reason and says what wiping out means (m3).

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

decisions.choice: "transgressions" (Literal), "actes de révolte" (Balanced), "révoltes" (Readable) for pesha'; "faute" for 'awon and "péché" for chatta't
decisions.reason: The psalm uses three words for wrongdoing (meaning decision m4). French keeps three distinct words, so the reader can follow them through verses 3-11; Balanced and Readable say plainly that pesha' is rebellion against God.

decisions.choice: "maasi" (L), "matendo ya uasi" (B) for transgressions; "dhambi" for sin and "uovu" or "hatia" for iniquity, keeping the Hebrew's three words apart through the psalm
decisions.reason: "Uasi" is rebellion, the sense of the Hebrew word; "makosa" (mistakes, wrongs) would blur it into ordinary failings.

decisions.choice: tú to God, with deity_pronoun spans on tú, tu, ti, te
decisions.reason: The psalmist speaks to God with "tú", the ordinary Spanish second person of prayer; the pronouns carry the deity_pronoun setting where the English has it. Where only the verb ending shows the person, there is no word to mark.

decisions.choice: "Xin ... lạy Đức Chúa Trời" for the psalmist's requests to God
decisions.reason: A request to God in Vietnamese prayer is made with "xin", and God is called on with "Lạy"; a bare "hãy" would sound like an order. The requests through the psalm keep this form.

decisions.choice: "lòng thương xót" (L), "lòng trắc ẩn" (B) for compassion; "sự vi phạm" (L), "hành vi phản nghịch" (B) for transgressions
decisions.reason: Compassion here is tender, motherly mercy, and transgressions are acts of rebellion (see the meaning decisions); the words keep those senses apart from "tình yêu thương thành tín" and from plain "tội" (sin).

decisions.choice: The whole psalm is spoken to God in 합쇼체; the singer is "저/제" and God is addressed by title, "주님" (no deity_pronoun spans in Korean)
decisions.reason: Style guide section 7a (speech levels in prayer); as the published Psalm 139.

decisions.choice: "반역" (L), "거역한 일들" (B, R) for the Hebrew word for transgressions
decisions.reason: The word means acts of rebellion (meaning decision m4); "허물" is the familiar church word but says only a fault. Korean keeps three different words for the three Hebrew words for sin in verses 3-7: "반역/거역", "죄악/죄" (iniquity, guilt) and "죄" (sin).

decisions.choice: Mostra-me favor (L); sê bondoso comigo (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb asks for kindness given freely to someone who has no claim on it. "Misericórdia" and "compaixão" are kept for the word of the next line, God's tender, motherly mercy (m2), so the two words stay distinct; this also keeps the psalm's famous opening in its own wording.

decisions.choice: risca (L); apaga (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb wipes writing out of a record (m3). Literal says "riscar", striking a name off a list, to keep the picture, here and in verse 11; Balanced and Readable say the ordinary "apagar", Readable adding "o registro" as the English adds "the record".

source.text: הֶ֭רֶב כַּבְּסֵ֣נִי מֵעֲוֺנִ֑י וּֽמֵחַטָּאתִ֥י טַהֲרֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Much wash me from my iniquity, and from my sin cleanse me.

en.L: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity, \q and from my sin cleanse me.
en.B: Scrub me completely clean of my guilt, \q and purify me from my sin.
en.R: Wash away every bit of the evil I have done. \q Make me clean from my sin.

fr.L: Lave-moi à fond de ma faute, \q et de mon péché purifie-moi.
fr.B: Nettoie-moi entièrement de ma faute, \q et rends-moi pur de mon péché.
fr.R: Lave jusqu’à la moindre trace du mal que j’ai fait. \q Rends-moi pur de mon péché.

sw.L: Nifue kabisa kutoka uovu wangu, \q na kutoka dhambi yangu nisafishe.
sw.B: Nisugue mpaka niwe safi kabisa kutoka hatia yangu, \q na unisafishe na dhambi yangu.
sw.R: Osha kila chembe ya uovu niliofanya. \q Nifanye safi kutoka dhambi yangu.

es.L: Lávame a fondo de mi iniquidad, \q y de mi pecado purifícame.
es.B: Restriégame hasta dejarme del todo limpio de mi culpa, \q y purifícame de mi pecado.
es.R: Lava todo el mal que he hecho, hasta lo último. \q Límpiame de mi pecado.

vi.L: Xin rửa tôi thật sạch khỏi sự gian ác của tôi, \q và xin tẩy sạch tôi khỏi tội lỗi tôi.
vi.B: Xin cọ rửa tôi cho thật sạch mọi vết tội, \q và xin thanh tẩy tôi khỏi tội lỗi tôi.
vi.R: Xin rửa sạch từng chút điều ác tôi đã làm. \q Xin làm cho tôi sạch khỏi tội lỗi.

ko.L: 저의 죄악에서 저를 깨끗이 씻어 주시고, \q 저의 죄에서 저를 정결하게 해 주십시오.
ko.B: 제 죄악을 말끔히 씻어 주시고, \q 제 죄에서 저를 깨끗하게 해 주십시오.
ko.R: 제가 저지른 악을 하나도 남김없이 씻어 주십시오. \q 제 죄에서 저를 깨끗하게 해 주십시오.

pt.L: Lava-me a fundo da minha iniquidade, \q e do meu pecado purifica-me.
pt.B: Esfrega-me até sair toda a minha culpa, \q e tira o meu pecado, para que eu fique puro.
pt.R: Lava todo o mal que eu fiz, até não sobrar nada. \q Deixa-me limpo do meu pecado.

decisions.choice: much: the form to be read
decisions.reason: The written text has the adverb "greatly" (harbeh); the form to be read is the command "make much" (herev). The words here follow the form to be read; both mean "wash me thoroughly".

decisions.choice: wash: launder, scrub clean
decisions.reason: The verb (kavas) is used for washing clothes by beating and treading them (Exodus 19:10), not for bathing. David asks to be scrubbed like a stained garment.

decisions.choice: cleanse: make clean for worship
decisions.reason: The verb (taher) is the word the priests used when they declared a person clean and fit to come before God again (Leviticus 13:6).

decisions.choice: iniquity: guilt
decisions.reason: As in verse 3, the word ('awon) means the crooked act and the guilt that clings to it.

decisions.choice: guilt
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the sense of 'awon (m4).

decisions.choice: "nifue" (launder me) at Literal
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is the one used for washing clothes by treading and scrubbing; Swahili "kufua" is that same washing of cloth.

decisions.choice: Esfrega-me
decisions.reason: The verb is the one for laundering cloth by scrubbing and beating it (m2), not for bathing; Balanced says "esfregar" to keep that picture, as the English says "Scrub". Literal keeps "Lava-me a fundo", and "puro" is the word for ritual cleanness (m3), as in the Pentateuch.

source.text: כִּֽי־פְ֭שָׁעַי אֲנִ֣י אֵדָ֑ע וְחַטָּאתִ֖י נֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִֽיד׃

records.literal_gloss: For my transgressions I know, and my sin [is] before me continually.

en.L: For my transgressions I know, \q and my sin [is] before me continually.
en.B: I myself know my rebellious acts, \q and my sin is never out of my sight.
en.R: I know the wrong things I have done. \q I can never stop thinking about my sin.

fr.L: Car mes transgressions, moi, je [les] connais, \q et mon péché [est] devant moi continuellement.
fr.B: Moi-même je reconnais mes actes de révolte, \q et mon péché ne quitte jamais mes yeux.
fr.R: Je connais le mal que j’ai fait. \q Je ne peux pas m’empêcher de penser à mon péché.

sw.L: Kwa maana maasi yangu ninayajua, \q na dhambi yangu [iko] mbele yangu siku zote.
sw.B: Mimi mwenyewe ninayajua matendo yangu ya uasi, \q na dhambi yangu haiondoki machoni pangu.
sw.R: Ninajua mabaya niliyotenda. \q Siwezi kuacha kuifikiria dhambi yangu.

es.L: Porque mis transgresiones yo las conozco, \q y mi pecado [está] delante de mí continuamente.
es.B: Yo mismo reconozco mis actos de rebeldía, \q y mi pecado nunca se aparta de mi vista.
es.R: Sé las cosas malas que he hecho. \q No puedo dejar de pensar en mi pecado.

vi.L: Vì các sự vi phạm của tôi, chính tôi biết, \q và tội lỗi tôi [ở] trước mặt tôi luôn luôn.
vi.B: Chính tôi nhận biết những hành vi phản nghịch của mình, \q và tội lỗi tôi không bao giờ rời khỏi mắt tôi.
vi.R: Tôi biết những điều sai trái tôi đã làm. \q Tôi không thể nào thôi nghĩ đến tội lỗi mình.

ko.L: 이는 제가 저의 반역들을 알고, \q 저의 죄가 늘 제 앞에 [있기] 때문입니다.
ko.B: 제가 거역한 일들을 저 스스로 알고 있으니, \q 제 죄가 한시도 제 눈앞에서 떠나지 않습니다.
ko.R: 제가 잘못한 일들을 저는 압니다. \q 제 죄가 한순간도 머리에서 떠나지 않습니다.

pt.L: Porque as minhas transgressões eu conheço, \q e o meu pecado [está] diante de mim continuamente.
pt.B: Eu mesmo reconheço os meus atos de rebeldia, \q e o meu pecado nunca sai da minha frente.
pt.R: Eu sei das coisas erradas que fiz. \q Não consigo parar de pensar no meu pecado.

decisions.choice: I know: I myself admit it
decisions.reason: The Hebrew adds the pronoun "I" for emphasis. David does not wait to be accused; he owns what he has done.

decisions.choice: before me continually: it is always in view
decisions.reason: His sin stands in front of him and he cannot look away from it, as 38:18 says of pain.

decisions.choice: rebellious acts
decisions.reason: As in verse 3.

decisions.choice: I can never stop thinking about my sin
alternatives: my sin is before me continually
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (m2).

source.text: לְךָ֤ לְבַדְּךָ֨׀חָטָאתִי֮ וְהָרַ֥ע בְּעֵינֶ֗יךָ עָ֫שִׂ֥יתִי לְ֭מַעַן תִּצְדַּ֥ק בְּדָבְרֶ֗ךָ תִּזְכֶּ֥ה בְשָׁפְטֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Against you, you alone, I have sinned, and the evil in your eyes I have done, so that you are in the right when you speak, pure when you judge.

en.L: Against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} alone, I have sinned, \q and done what [is] evil in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} eyes, \q so that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are in the right when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} speak, \q [and] pure when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} judge.
en.B: I have sinned against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} alone, \q and done what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} see as evil. \q So {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are shown to be right in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} sentence \q and pure in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} judgment.
en.R: You are the one I have sinned against, only {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q I have done what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} say is evil. \q So when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} speak against me, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are right. \q When {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} judge me, no one can say {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are wrong.

fr.L: Contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} seul, j’ai péché, \q et j’ai fait ce qui [est] mal à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} yeux, \q de sorte que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es juste quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} parles, \q [et] pur quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} juges.
fr.B: J’ai péché contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} seul, \q et j’ai fait ce qui est mal à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} yeux. \q Ainsi {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} montres juste dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sentence \q et pur dans {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} jugement.
fr.R: C’est contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} que j’ai péché, contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} seul. \q J’ai fait ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} dis être mal. \q Alors quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} parles contre moi, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as raison. \q Quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me juges, personne ne peut dire que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as tort.

sw.L: Dhidi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} peke {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, nimetenda dhambi, \q na kufanya yaliyo maovu machoni {{deity_pronoun:pako|Pako}}, \q ili {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uwe na haki unaponena, \q [na] safi unapohukumu.
sw.B: Nimekutendea dhambi {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} peke {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, \q na kufanya yale {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unayoyaona kuwa maovu. \q Kwa hiyo {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unaonekana kuwa wa haki katika hukumu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} \q na safi katika uamuzi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.R: Wewe ndiye niliyekukosea, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} peke {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}. \q Nimefanya yale {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unayosema ni maovu. \q Kwa hiyo unaponilaumu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uko sawa. \q Unaponihukumu, hakuna awezaye kusema umekosea.

es.L: Contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} solo, he pecado, \q y he hecho lo [que es] malo ante {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} ojos, \q para que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} seas justo cuando hablas, \q [y] puro cuando juzgas.
es.B: He pecado contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, solo contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, \q y he hecho lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} ves como malo. \q Así se muestra que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} tienes razón en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sentencia \q y que eres puro en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} juicio.
es.R: Contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} he pecado, solo contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. \q He hecho lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} dices que es malo. \q Por eso, cuando hablas contra mí, tienes razón. \q Cuando me juzgas, nadie puede decir que estás equivocado.

vi.L: Nghịch cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, chỉ một mình {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tôi đã phạm tội, \q và đã làm điều ác trong mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q để {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được công chính khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán, \q [và] trong sạch khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xét xử.
vi.B: Tôi đã phạm tội nghịch cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, chỉ nghịch cùng một mình {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và đã làm điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xem là ác. \q Vì thế {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được tỏ ra là đúng khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tuyên án, \q và trong sạch khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán xét.
vi.R: Ngài là Đấng tôi đã phạm tội nghịch lại, chỉ một mình {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Tôi đã làm điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói là ác. \q Vì vậy khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lên án tôi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là đúng. \q Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xét xử tôi, không ai có thể nói {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sai.

ko.L: 주님께, 오직 주님께 제가 죄를 지었고, \q 주님의 눈에 악한 것을 행하였습니다. \q 그러므로 주님께서 말씀하실 때 옳으시고, \q 판단하실 때 순전하십니다.
ko.B: 제가 주님께, 오직 주님께만 죄를 지었고, \q 주님 보시기에 악한 일을 했습니다. \q 그러니 주님의 판결은 옳으시고 \q 주님의 심판은 흠이 없으십니다.
ko.R: 제가 죄를 지은 상대는 주님, 오직 주님이십니다. \q 저는 주님께서 악하다고 하시는 일을 했습니다. \q 그러니 주님께서 저를 꾸짖으실 때 주님이 옳으십니다. \q 주님께서 저를 심판하실 때 아무도 주님이 틀리셨다고 말할 수 없습니다.

pt.L: Contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, só contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, eu pequei, \q e fiz o que [é] mau aos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} olhos, \q para que sejas justificado quando falas, \q [e] puro quando julgas.
pt.B: Pequei contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} somente, \q e fiz o que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} vês como mau. \q Assim fica claro que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} tens razão quando falas \q e és puro quando julgas.
pt.R: Foi contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} que eu pequei, só contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. \q Fiz o que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} dizes que é mau. \q Por isso {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} estás certo no que dizes contra mim. \q Quando {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me julgas, ninguém pode dizer que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} estás errado.

decisions.choice: against you alone: all sin is finally against God
decisions.reason: David wronged Bathsheba and Uriah, yet he says he has sinned against God alone. Every wrong done to another person breaks God's command and is first an offense against him, as David said to Nathan (2 Samuel 12:13).

decisions.choice: so that: with the result that
decisions.reason: The words (lema'an) usually state a purpose. Here they say what follows from David's confession: it shows that God's verdict on him is just.

decisions.choice: in the right, pure: proved just and without fault
decisions.reason: The first verb (tsadaq) is used of the party a court declares to be in the right; the second (zakah) means to be clean or blameless.

decisions.choice: quoted in Romans 3:4
decisions.reason: Paul quotes the second half of this verse, from the ancient Greek translation, which reads "and prevail when you are judged", to show that God is true even when people are not.

decisions.choice: speak against me ... judge me
decisions.reason: Readable names the one judged, David himself (m1).

decisions.choice: para que sejas justificado quando falas (L); fica claro que tu tens razão quando falas (B); tu estás certo no que dizes (R)
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this verse in Romans 3:4 (m4), so the first half uses the Portuguese of Romans 3:4 at each level, which fits the Hebrew "be in the right when you speak" (m3); Balanced says "quando falas" rather than the English "in your sentence" for that reason. The second half follows the Hebrew, "puro quando julgas", where Paul's Greek reads "prevail when you are judged".

source.text: הֵן־בְּעָו֥וֹן חוֹלָ֑לְתִּי וּ֝בְחֵ֗טְא יֶֽחֱמַ֥תְנִי אִמִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, in iniquity I was brought forth, and in sin conceived me my mother.

en.L: Look, in iniquity I was brought forth, \q and in sin my mother conceived me.
en.B: Indeed, guilt was with me when I was born; \q sin was there when my mother conceived me.
en.R: The truth is, I have been a sinner for as long as I have lived, \q even before I was born.

fr.L: Voici, dans la faute j’ai été enfanté, \q et dans le péché ma mère m’a conçu.
fr.B: Oui, la faute était là quand je suis né ; \q le péché était là quand ma mère m’a conçu.
fr.R: En vérité, je suis pécheur depuis le début de ma vie, \q avant même ma naissance.

sw.L: Tazama, katika uovu nilizaliwa, \q na katika dhambi mama yangu alinichukua mimba.
sw.B: Kweli, hatia ilikuwa nami nilipozaliwa; \q dhambi ilikuwepo mama yangu aliponichukua mimba.
sw.R: Ukweli ni kwamba nimekuwa mwenye dhambi tangu nianze kuishi, \q hata kabla sijazaliwa.

es.L: He aquí, en iniquidad fui dado a luz, \q y en pecado mi madre me concibió.
es.B: En verdad, la culpa estaba conmigo cuando nací; \q el pecado ya estaba allí cuando mi madre me concibió.
es.R: La verdad es que he sido pecador toda mi vida, \q incluso antes de nacer.

vi.L: Kìa, trong sự gian ác tôi đã được sinh ra, \q và trong tội lỗi mẹ tôi đã thụ thai tôi.
vi.B: Thật vậy, tội lỗi đã ở với tôi từ lúc tôi chào đời; \q tội lỗi đã có đó khi mẹ tôi mang thai tôi.
vi.R: Sự thật là tôi đã là người có tội suốt cả đời mình, \q ngay cả trước khi tôi sinh ra.

ko.L: 보십시오, 죄악 가운데 제가 태어났고, \q 죄 가운데 제 어머니가 저를 잉태하였습니다.
ko.B: 참으로 저는 태어날 때부터 죄악과 함께였고, \q 어머니가 저를 배었을 때부터 죄가 거기 있었습니다.
ko.R: 사실 저는 사는 동안 내내 죄인이었고, \q 태어나기 전부터 그러했습니다.

pt.L: Eis que em iniquidade fui dado à luz, \q e em pecado a minha mãe me concebeu.
pt.B: De fato, a culpa já estava comigo quando nasci; \q o pecado já estava lá quando a minha mãe me concebeu.
pt.R: A verdade é que eu sou pecador desde o começo da minha vida, \q desde antes de nascer.

decisions.choice: in iniquity, in sin: sin goes back to the start of his life
alternatives: his mother sinned when she conceived him
decisions.reason: David is not saying that conception or birth is sinful, or blaming his mother. He says that his sin is not a single lapse: it reaches back to the very beginning of his life (58:4; Genesis 8:21).

decisions.choice: brought forth: born in labor
decisions.reason: The verb (chul) means to writhe, and in this form to be brought to birth through labor pains.

decisions.choice: Look: a word that calls attention
decisions.reason: The word (hen) points to what follows. Verses 7 and 8 both begin with it, setting David's sinful beginning beside the truth God wants deep within.

decisions.choice: I have been a sinner for as long as I have lived, even before I was born
alternatives: I was born in guilt, and my mother conceived me in sin
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of the two pictures (m1) without suggesting that his mother was to blame.

source.text: הֵן־אֱ֭מֶת חָפַ֣צְתָּ בַטֻּח֑וֹת וּ֝בְסָתֻ֗ם חָכְמָ֥ה תוֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, truth you desire in the inward parts, and in [the] hidden [part] wisdom you make me know.

en.L: Look, truth {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} desire in the inward parts, \q and in the hidden [part] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} make me know wisdom.
en.B: Yet {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} long for truth deep within, \q and in my secret self {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} make wisdom known to me.
en.R: But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} want truth to fill a person all the way through. \q Deep in my heart, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} show me how to be wise.

fr.L: Voici, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} désires la vérité dans les reins, \q et dans le [lieu] caché {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me fais connaître la sagesse.
fr.B: Mais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} veux la vérité au plus profond de l’être, \q et dans le secret de mon cœur {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me fais connaître la sagesse.
fr.R: Mais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} veux que la vérité remplisse une personne tout entière. \q Au fond de mon cœur, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’apprends à être sage.

sw.L: Tazama, kweli {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unaitaka katika sehemu za ndani, \q na katika [sehemu] iliyofichika {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unanijulisha hekima.
sw.B: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unatamani kweli ndani kabisa, \q na katika nafsi yangu ya siri {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unanijulisha hekima.
sw.R: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unataka kweli imjaze mtu kabisa. \q Ndani ya moyo wangu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unanionyesha jinsi ya kuwa na hekima.

es.L: He aquí, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} deseas la verdad en lo íntimo, \q y en lo oculto me haces conocer sabiduría.
es.B: Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} anhelas la verdad en lo más hondo, \q y en mi interior secreto me das a conocer la sabiduría.
es.R: Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} quieres que la verdad llene a una persona por completo. \q En lo profundo de mi corazón, me enseñas a ser sabio.

vi.L: Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn sự chân thật ở bề trong, \q và trong nơi kín giấu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho tôi biết sự khôn ngoan.
vi.B: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khao khát sự chân thật sâu tận bên trong, \q và trong con người thầm kín của tôi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho tôi biết sự khôn ngoan.
vi.R: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn sự chân thật đầy dẫy trong con người từ trong ra ngoài. \q Sâu trong lòng tôi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chỉ cho tôi cách sống khôn ngoan.

ko.L: 보십시오, 주님께서는 속에 있는 진실을 원하시니, \q 은밀한 [곳에서] 저에게 지혜를 알게 하십니다.
ko.B: 그러나 주님께서는 마음 깊은 곳의 진실을 바라시고, \q 제 속 깊은 곳에서 지혜를 알려 주십니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 사람이 속속들이 진실하기를 바라십니다. \q 제 마음 깊은 곳에서 지혜롭게 사는 법을 보여 주십니다.

pt.L: Eis que a verdade {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} desejas no íntimo, \q e no [lugar] escondido {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me fazes conhecer a sabedoria.
pt.B: Mas {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} queres a verdade no fundo do ser, \q e no meu interior secreto {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me dás a conhecer a sabedoria.
pt.R: Mas {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} queres que a verdade encha uma pessoa por inteiro. \q Bem no fundo do meu coração, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me mostras como ser sábio.

decisions.choice: inward parts: the hidden inner self
decisions.reason: The word (tuchot) is rare (Job 38:36) and its exact sense is uncertain. It goes with "the hidden part" in the next line: the inmost being that no one else sees.

decisions.choice: truth: what is true and faithful
decisions.reason: The word ('emet) means what is reliable and true. God wants a person to be true inside, not only in outward acts.

decisions.choice: you make me know: a statement
decisions.reason: The verb is in the unfinished form, which can state what God does or ask for it. Read either way, wisdom comes from God into the place where sin had been (verse 7).

decisions.choice: a person all the way through
decisions.reason: Readable says what the inward parts are (m1).

decisions.choice: "les reins" for tuchot at Literal
decisions.reason: The rare word names the hidden inner parts of a person (meaning decision m1). French Literal uses "les reins", the traditional French picture of the hidden self; Balanced and Readable say what it means.

source.text: תְּחַטְּאֵ֣נִי בְאֵז֣וֹב וְאֶטְהָ֑ר תְּ֝כַבְּסֵ֗נִי וּמִשֶּׁ֥לֶג אַלְבִּֽין׃

records.literal_gloss: You will un-sin me with hyssop and I will be clean; you will wash me and more than snow I will be white.

en.L: Purge me of sin with hyssop, and I will be clean; \q wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
en.B: Take away my sin with hyssop, and I will be pure; \q when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} wash me, I will be whiter than snow.
en.R: Take my sin away, as a priest makes someone clean with a hyssop branch. \q Then I will be pure. \q When {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} wash me, I will be even whiter than snow.

fr.L: Ôte mon péché avec l’hysope, et je serai pur ; \q lave-moi, et je serai plus blanc que la neige.
fr.B: Enlève mon péché avec l’hysope, et je serai pur ; \q quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me laveras, je serai plus blanc que la neige.
fr.R: Enlève mon péché, comme un prêtre purifie quelqu’un avec une branche d’hysope. \q Alors je serai pur. \q Quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me laveras, je serai encore plus blanc que la neige.

sw.L: Niondolee dhambi kwa hisopo, nami nitakuwa safi; \q nifue, nami nitakuwa mweupe kupita theluji.
sw.B: Uiondoe dhambi yangu kwa hisopo, nami nitakuwa safi kabisa; \q {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ukinifua, nitakuwa mweupe zaidi ya theluji.
sw.R: Iondoe dhambi yangu, kama kuhani anavyomtakasa mtu kwa tawi la hisopo. \q Ndipo nitakapokuwa safi. \q Utakaponiosha, nitakuwa mweupe hata kuliko theluji.

es.L: Límpiame del pecado con hisopo, y quedaré puro; \q lávame, y quedaré más blanco que la nieve.
es.B: Quita mi pecado con hisopo, y seré puro; \q cuando {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me laves, seré más blanco que la nieve.
es.R: Quítame el pecado, como un sacerdote limpia a alguien con una rama de hisopo. \q Entonces seré puro. \q Cuando {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me laves, quedaré aún más blanco que la nieve.

vi.L: Xin dùng cây kinh giới tẩy tội tôi, thì tôi sẽ được sạch; \q xin rửa tôi, thì tôi sẽ trắng hơn tuyết.
vi.B: Xin dùng cây kinh giới cất tội tôi đi, thì tôi sẽ được tinh sạch; \q khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rửa tôi, tôi sẽ trắng hơn cả tuyết.
vi.R: Xin cất tội tôi đi, như thầy tế lễ dùng nhánh kinh giới làm cho người ta được sạch. \q Khi ấy tôi sẽ được tinh sạch. \q Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rửa tôi, tôi sẽ còn trắng hơn tuyết.

ko.L: 우슬초로 제 죄를 없애 주십시오, 그러면 제가 깨끗해질 것입니다. \q 저를 씻어 주십시오, 그러면 제가 눈보다 더 희어질 것입니다.
ko.B: 우슬초로 제 죄를 없애 주시면 제가 정결해지고, \q 주님께서 저를 씻어 주시면 제가 눈보다 희게 될 것입니다.
ko.R: 제사장이 우슬초 가지로 사람을 깨끗하게 하듯이 제 죄를 없애 주십시오. \q 그러면 제가 깨끗해질 것입니다. \q 주님께서 저를 씻어 주시면 저는 눈보다 더 하얗게 될 것입니다.

pt.L: Remove o meu pecado com hissopo, e serei puro; \q lava-me, e mais do que a neve serei branco.
pt.B: Tira o meu pecado com hissopo, e ficarei puro; \q quando {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me lavares, ficarei mais branco do que a neve.
pt.R: Tira o meu pecado, como um sacerdote purifica alguém com um ramo de hissopo. \q Então ficarei puro. \q Quando {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me lavares, vou ficar ainda mais branco do que a neve.

decisions.choice: hyssop: a plant used for sprinkling in cleansing rites
decisions.reason: Hyssop is a small bushy plant. A bunch of it was dipped in blood or water and used to sprinkle it: at the Passover (Exodus 12:22), to cleanse someone healed of a skin disease (Leviticus 14:4-7), and to cleanse someone who had touched a dead body (Numbers 19:18).

decisions.choice: purge of sin: take the sin away
decisions.reason: The verb is a form of the word "sin" (chata') that means to remove sin, the word used for the cleansing rites in Leviticus 14:49-52 and Numbers 19:19.

decisions.choice: you will cleanse, you will wash: requests
decisions.reason: The verbs are in the unfinished form, "you will cleanse me", but in a prayer they ask for what is wanted, and the next verbs say what will follow.

decisions.choice: whiter than snow
decisions.reason: Compare Isaiah 1:18: sins red as scarlet will be white as snow.

decisions.choice: as a priest makes someone clean with a hyssop branch
decisions.reason: Readable explains what hyssop was used for (m1).

decisions.choice: "cây kinh giới" for hyssop
decisions.reason: Hyssop was a small bushy herb used to sprinkle water or blood in cleansing rites (see the meaning decision). "kinh giới" names a related herb Vietnamese readers know and is the name used for it in Vietnamese Bibles; the exact plant is not certain.

decisions.choice: "우슬초" (hyssop) at Literal and Balanced; Readable "우슬초 가지로" with the priest's act explained
decisions.reason: Hyssop was the plant used to sprinkle water or blood in cleansing rites (meaning decision m1); "우슬초" is the Korean Bible name for it.

source.text: תַּ֭שְׁמִיעֵנִי שָׂשׂ֣וֹן וְשִׂמְחָ֑ה תָּ֝גֵ֗לְנָה עֲצָמ֥וֹת דִּכִּֽיתָ׃

records.literal_gloss: You will make me hear joy and gladness; may rejoice [the] bones you have crushed.

en.L: Make me hear joy and gladness; \q let the bones [that] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have crushed rejoice.
en.B: Fill my ears with gladness and joy; \q let the bones {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} crushed dance.
en.R: Let me hear happy sounds again. \q You have crushed me, but now let me be glad.

fr.L: Fais-moi entendre la joie et l’allégresse ; \q que les os [que] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as broyés exultent.
fr.B: Remplis mes oreilles d’allégresse et de joie ; \q que les os que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as broyés se mettent à danser.
fr.R: Fais-moi entendre de nouveau des chants de joie. \q Tu m’as écrasé, mais maintenant rends-moi heureux.

sw.L: Ufanye nisikie furaha na shangwe; \q mifupa ambayo {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umeiponda na ishangilie.
sw.B: Yajaze masikio yangu shangwe na furaha; \q mifupa ambayo {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uliivunja na icheze.
sw.R: Niruhusu nisikie tena sauti za furaha. \q Umeniponda, lakini sasa niache nifurahi.

es.L: Hazme oír gozo y alegría; \q que se regocijen los huesos que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has quebrantado.
es.B: Llena mis oídos de alegría y gozo; \q que dancen los huesos que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} aplastaste.
es.R: Déjame oír otra vez sonidos alegres. \q Tú me has aplastado, pero ahora deja que me alegre.

vi.L: Xin cho tôi nghe sự vui mừng và hân hoan; \q nguyện các xương mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nghiền nát được vui mừng.
vi.B: Xin cho tai tôi đầy tiếng hân hoan vui mừng; \q nguyện những xương cốt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đập nát được nhảy múa.
vi.R: Xin cho tôi lại được nghe những âm thanh vui vẻ. \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nghiền nát tôi, nhưng giờ đây xin cho tôi được vui mừng.

ko.L: 기쁨과 즐거움을 제게 들려주십시오. \q 주님께서 부수신 뼈들이 기뻐하게 해 주십시오.
ko.B: 기쁨과 즐거움의 소리를 제 귀에 채워 주십시오. \q 주님께서 꺾으신 뼈들이 춤추게 해 주십시오.
ko.R: 제가 다시 즐거운 소리를 듣게 해 주십시오. \q 주님께서 저를 꺾으셨지만, 이제는 기뻐하게 해 주십시오.

pt.L: Faz-me ouvir alegria e contentamento; \q que os ossos [que] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} esmagaste se alegrem.
pt.B: Enche os meus ouvidos de contentamento e alegria; \q que dancem os ossos que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} esmagaste.
pt.R: Deixa-me ouvir de novo sons de alegria. \q Tu me esmagaste, mas agora deixa-me ficar contente.

decisions.choice: bones: the whole person
decisions.reason: The bones stand for the whole self, body and spirit (6:3; 35:10). Being crushed is the weight of guilt and of God's judgment that David has felt (32:3-4).

decisions.choice: rejoice: dance for joy
decisions.reason: The verb (gil) is a word for lively, open joy; it may picture going round in a dance.

decisions.choice: you will make me hear: a request
decisions.reason: As in verse 9, the unfinished form asks for what is wanted. Hearing joy may mean hearing God's word of forgiveness, or the sounds of celebration in worship.

decisions.choice: You have crushed me
decisions.reason: Readable says what the bones stand for (m1).

decisions.choice: again
decisions.reason: Readable adds "again": the joy he asks for is joy he once had (verse 14).

source.text: הַסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נֶיךָ מֵחֲטָאָ֑י וְֽכָל־עֲוֺ֖נֹתַ֣י מְחֵֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Hide your face from my sins, and all my iniquities wipe out.

en.L: Hide {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face from my sins, \q and wipe out all my iniquities.
en.B: Turn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face away from my sins, \q and erase all my guilt.
en.R: Do not look at my sins. \q Wipe away every wrong thing I have done.

fr.L: Cache {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face de mes péchés, \q et efface toutes mes fautes.
fr.B: Détourne {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} visage de mes péchés, \q et efface toutes mes fautes.
fr.R: Ne regarde plus mes péchés. \q Efface tout le mal que j’ai fait.

sw.L: Ficha uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mbali na dhambi zangu, \q na maovu yangu yote uyafute.
sw.B: Geuza uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mbali na dhambi zangu, \q na ufute hatia yangu yote.
sw.R: Usizitazame dhambi zangu. \q Futa kila kosa nililolitenda.

es.L: Oculta {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro de mis pecados, \q y borra todas mis iniquidades.
es.B: Aparta {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro de mis pecados, \q y borra toda mi culpa.
es.R: No mires mis pecados. \q Borra todo lo malo que he hecho.

vi.L: Xin ẩn mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khỏi các tội lỗi của tôi, \q và xin xóa bỏ mọi sự gian ác của tôi.
vi.B: Xin quay mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khỏi các tội lỗi tôi, \q và xin xóa sạch mọi vết tội của tôi.
vi.R: Xin đừng nhìn đến tội lỗi tôi. \q Xin xóa đi mọi điều sai trái tôi đã làm.

ko.L: 제 죄들에서 주님의 얼굴을 가리시고, \q 제 모든 죄악을 지워 주십시오.
ko.B: 제 죄에서 주님의 얼굴을 돌리시고, \q 제 모든 죄악을 지워 주십시오.
ko.R: 제 죄를 보지 말아 주십시오. \q 제가 저지른 잘못을 하나도 남김없이 지워 주십시오.

pt.L: Esconde a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} face dos meus pecados, \q e risca todas as minhas iniquidades.
pt.B: Desvia o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} rosto dos meus pecados, \q e apaga toda a minha culpa.
pt.R: Não olhes para os meus pecados. \q Apaga todas as coisas erradas que eu fiz.

decisions.choice: hide your face from my sins: stop looking at them
decisions.reason: Elsewhere David begs God not to hide his face from him (13:2; 27:9). Here he asks God to hide his face from his sins: not to keep them in view and hold them against him.

decisions.choice: wipe out: erase
decisions.reason: The same verb as in verse 3. The prayer for cleansing begins and ends with it.

decisions.choice: guilt
decisions.reason: As in verse 4.

decisions.choice: Do not look at my sins
alternatives: Hide your face from my sins
decisions.reason: Readable says what the idiom means (m1).

source.text: לֵ֣ב טָ֭הוֹר בְּרָא־לִ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְר֥וּחַ נָ֝כ֗וֹן חַדֵּ֥שׁ בְּקִרְבִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: A heart pure create for me, God, and a spirit steadfast renew in my inner [being].

en.L: A pure heart create for me, God, \q and a steadfast spirit make new in my inner [being].
en.B: God, create a pure heart for me, \q and make my spirit new and steady inside me.
en.R: God, give me a pure heart, one that only {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} can make. \q Make my spirit strong and steady again.

fr.L: Un cœur pur, crée-[le] pour moi, Dieu, \q et un esprit ferme, renouvelle-[le] au-dedans de moi.
fr.B: Dieu, crée pour moi un cœur pur, \q et rends-moi un esprit neuf et ferme au-dedans de moi.
fr.R: Dieu, donne-moi un cœur pur, un cœur que {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} seul peux faire. \q Rends mon esprit fort et ferme à nouveau.

sw.L: Moyo uliotakasika uniumbie, Ee Mungu, \q na roho imara uifanye mpya ndani yangu.
sw.B: Ee Mungu, niumbie moyo uliotakasika, \q na uifanye roho yangu kuwa mpya na imara ndani yangu.
sw.R: Ee Mungu, nipe moyo safi, moyo ambao {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} peke {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} unaweza kuuumba. \q Ifanye roho yangu iwe na nguvu na imara tena.

es.L: Un corazón puro crea para mí, oh Dios, \q y un espíritu firme haz nuevo en mi interior.
es.B: Dios, crea para mí un corazón puro, \q y haz mi espíritu nuevo y firme dentro de mí.
es.R: Dios, dame un corazón puro, uno que solo {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} puedes hacer. \q Haz que mi espíritu vuelva a ser fuerte y firme.

vi.L: Một tấm lòng trong sạch, xin dựng nên cho tôi, lạy Đức Chúa Trời, \q và một tâm linh kiên định, xin làm mới lại trong [con người] bề trong tôi.
vi.B: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin tạo nên cho tôi một tấm lòng trong sạch, \q và làm cho tâm linh tôi được đổi mới và vững vàng bên trong tôi.
vi.R: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin ban cho tôi một tấm lòng trong sạch, một tấm lòng chỉ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mới có thể làm nên. \q Xin làm cho tâm linh tôi mạnh mẽ và vững vàng trở lại.

ko.L: 깨끗한 마음을 제 안에 창조해 주십시오, 하나님. \q 그리고 흔들리지 않는 영을 제 속에 새롭게 해 주십시오.
ko.B: 하나님, 저에게 깨끗한 마음을 지어 주시고, \q 제 속의 영을 새롭고 굳건하게 해 주십시오.
ko.R: 하나님, 저에게 깨끗한 마음을 주십시오. 그런 마음은 주님만이 만드실 수 있습니다. \q 제 영을 다시 강하고 든든하게 해 주십시오.

pt.L: Um coração puro cria para mim, ó Deus, \q e um espírito firme renova no meu interior.
pt.B: Ó Deus, cria um coração puro para mim, \q e torna o meu espírito novo e firme por dentro.
pt.R: Ó Deus, dá-me um coração puro, um coração que só {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} podes fazer. \q Faz o meu espírito forte e firme de novo.

decisions.choice: create: bring something new into being
decisions.reason: The verb (bara') always has God as its subject (Genesis 1:1). David does not ask for his old heart to be mended but for God to make a new one.

decisions.choice: heart, spirit: the inner person
decisions.reason: The heart is the mind and will, where choices are made; the spirit is the inner life and its strength.

decisions.choice: steadfast: firm, settled
decisions.reason: The word (nakhon) means firmly fixed (57:8; 78:37): a spirit that holds steady in loyalty to God.

decisions.choice: a new heart and a new spirit
decisions.reason: Compare Ezekiel 36:26, where God promises his people a new heart and a new spirit.

decisions.choice: one that only you can make
decisions.reason: Readable explains the verb "create" (m1).

decisions.choice: "dựng nên" (L), "tạo nên" (B) for create; "tâm linh" for spirit
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for God's creating something new (see the meaning decision), so Vietnamese uses a creation word rather than plain "làm" (make). "tâm linh" is the inner spirit, kept apart from "Thánh Linh" in the next verse.

decisions.choice: "창조해 주십시오" (create) at Literal; Balanced "지어 주시고", Readable "주십시오"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is the one used only of God's creating something new (meaning decision m1); Literal keeps "창조", Balanced uses the native verb "짓다", and Readable says the point in the added clause, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: cria ... para mim
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "for me": David asks God to make him a new heart, not to mend the old one (m1), so Portuguese says "criar ... para mim", and keeps "criar", the verb of Genesis 1:1. The familiar line "Cria em mim um coração puro" is also the wording of copyrighted versions, which this translation does not reproduce.

source.text: אַל־תַּשְׁלִיכֵ֥נִי מִלְּפָנֶ֑יךָ וְר֥וּחַ קָ֝דְשְׁךָ֗ אַל־תִּקַּ֥ח מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: Do not cast me from before your face, and [the] spirit of your holiness do not take from me.

en.L: Do not cast me away from before {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face, \q and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} Holy Spirit do not take from me.
en.B: Do not drive me away from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} presence, \q and do not withdraw {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} Holy Spirit from me.
en.R: Do not push me away from {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q Please let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} Holy Spirit stay with me.

fr.L: Ne me rejette pas de devant {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face, \q et {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} Esprit saint, ne [le] prends pas loin de moi.
fr.B: Ne me chasse pas loin de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} présence, \q et ne me retire pas {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} Esprit saint.
fr.R: Ne me repousse pas loin de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. \q Laisse, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en prie, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} Esprit saint rester avec moi.

sw.L: Usinitupe mbali kutoka mbele ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, \q na Roho {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Mtakatifu usimwondoe kwangu.
sw.B: Usinifukuze mbali na uwepo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, \q wala usimwondoe Roho {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Mtakatifu kwangu.
sw.R: Usinisukume mbali {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}. \q Tafadhali, Roho {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Mtakatifu na abaki pamoja nami.

es.L: No me arrojes de delante de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro, \q y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} Espíritu Santo no lo quites de mí.
es.B: No me alejes de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} presencia, \q ni retires de mí {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} Espíritu Santo.
es.R: No me apartes de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. \q Por favor, deja que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} Espíritu Santo se quede conmigo.

vi.L: Xin đừng ném bỏ tôi khỏi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và Thánh Linh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xin đừng cất khỏi tôi.
vi.B: Xin đừng xua đuổi tôi khỏi sự hiện diện của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và xin đừng rút Thánh Linh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khỏi tôi.
vi.R: Xin đừng đẩy tôi xa khỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Xin cho Thánh Linh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở lại với tôi.

ko.L: 주님의 얼굴 앞에서 저를 쫓아내지 마시고, \q 주님의 거룩한 영을 제게서 거두지 마십시오.
ko.B: 주님 앞에서 저를 내쫓지 마시고, \q 주님의 성령을 제게서 거두어 가지 마십시오.
ko.R: 저를 주님에게서 밀어내지 마십시오. \q 주님의 성령께서 늘 제게 머물러 계시게 해 주십시오.

pt.L: Não me lances fora de diante da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} face, \q e o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} Espírito Santo não tires de mim.
pt.B: Não me expulses da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} presença, \q e não retires de mim o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} Espírito Santo.
pt.R: Não me empurres para longe de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. \q Por favor, deixa o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} Espírito Santo ficar comigo.

decisions.choice: your holy spirit: God's own Spirit present with David
decisions.reason: Only here and in Isaiah 63 does the Old Testament speak of God's "holy spirit". It is God's own presence and power, given to David when he was anointed king (1 Samuel 16:13). Christian readers hear in it the Holy Spirit of the New Testament, which is why it is capitalized, as "the Spirit of God" is in Genesis 1:2.

decisions.choice: do not take your Spirit: Saul's fate
decisions.reason: When David was anointed, the Spirit of the LORD left Saul (1 Samuel 16:14). David asks not to lose God's Spirit as Saul did.

decisions.choice: from before your face: from your presence
decisions.reason: To be before God's face is to live in his presence and favor (16:11).

decisions.choice: presence (B); away from you (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the idiom (m3).

decisions.choice: "Roho wako Mtakatifu", with capitals and personal agreement ("wako", "usimwondoe"), as the English "Holy Spirit"
alternatives: "roho yako takatifu", lower case with class 9 agreement
decisions.reason: The English reads God's own Spirit here (meaning decision m1) and capitalises it; Swahili writes "Roho Mtakatifu" with the agreement used for a person, as in the New Testament. A reader who takes the line as "your holy spirit" in a more general sense would write it in lower case.

decisions.choice: "주님의 거룩한 영" (L) and "주님의 성령" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is "the spirit of your holiness", God's own Spirit present with David (meaning decision m1); Literal keeps the phrase, Balanced and Readable use the ordinary Korean word for God's Holy Spirit, as the English capitalises it.

source.text: הָשִׁ֣יבָה לִּ֭י שְׂשׂ֣וֹן יִשְׁעֶ֑ךָ וְר֖וּחַ נְדִיבָ֣ה תִסְמְכֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Return to me [the] joy of your salvation, and [with] a willing spirit sustain me.

en.L: Bring back to me the joy of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} salvation, \q and with a willing spirit uphold me.
en.B: Give back to me the gladness of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} salvation, \q and keep me steady with a willing spirit.
en.R: Make me glad again that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} save me. \q Make me eager to do what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} want, and keep me going.

fr.L: Rends-moi la joie de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} salut, \q et d’un esprit généreux soutiens-moi.
fr.B: Redonne-moi l’allégresse de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} salut, \q et garde-moi ferme par un esprit de bonne volonté.
fr.R: Rends-moi heureux de nouveau que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me sauves. \q Donne-moi l’envie de faire ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} veux, et aide-moi à tenir.

sw.L: Nirejeshee shangwe ya wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, \q na kwa roho iliyo radhi unishikilie.
sw.B: Nipe tena furaha ya wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, \q na unidumishe imara kwa roho iliyo tayari.
sw.R: Nifanye nifurahi tena kwa kuwa {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unaniokoa. \q Nipe hamu ya kufanya yale {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unayotaka, na unidumishe.

es.L: Devuélveme el gozo de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} salvación, \q y con un espíritu generoso sostenme.
es.B: Dame otra vez la alegría de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} salvación, \q y mantenme firme con un espíritu dispuesto.
es.R: Hazme feliz otra vez porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me salvas. \q Dame ganas de hacer lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} quieres, y sostenme.

vi.L: Xin đem trở lại cho tôi niềm vui của sự cứu rỗi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và với một tâm linh sẵn lòng, xin nâng đỡ tôi.
vi.B: Xin cho tôi lại được niềm hân hoan vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải cứu, \q và giữ tôi vững vàng bằng một tâm linh sẵn lòng.
vi.R: Xin cho tôi lại được vui mừng vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cứu tôi. \q Xin làm cho tôi hăng hái làm điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn, và giữ cho tôi tiếp tục bước đi.

ko.L: 주님의 구원의 기쁨을 제게 돌려주시고, \q 기꺼이 따르는 영으로 저를 붙들어 주십시오.
ko.B: 주님께서 구원하시는 기쁨을 다시 누리게 해 주시고, \q 자원하는 영으로 저를 든든히 붙들어 주십시오.
ko.R: 주님께서 저를 구원하신다는 것을 다시 기뻐하게 해 주십시오. \q 주님께서 원하시는 일을 기꺼이 하고 싶은 마음을 주시고, 저를 붙들어 주십시오.

pt.L: Faz voltar a mim a alegria da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} salvação, \q e com um espírito disposto sustenta-me.
pt.B: Devolve-me o contentamento da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} salvação, \q e mantém-me firme com um espírito disposto.
pt.R: Faz-me ficar contente de novo porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me salvas. \q Dá-me vontade de fazer o que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} queres, e mantém-me de pé.

decisions.choice: your salvation: your rescue
decisions.reason: The word (yesha') means rescue and safety that God gives. David had known the joy of it and lost it through his sin.

decisions.choice: willing: generous, freely given
decisions.reason: The word (nediv) describes a person who gives freely and gladly (Exodus 35:5), and so also a noble person. David asks for a spirit that serves God willingly, not by force.

decisions.choice: with a willing spirit sustain me
alternatives: let a willing spirit sustain me
decisions.reason: The spirit may be the means by which God holds David up, or the one who holds him up. The sense is much the same.

decisions.choice: eager to do what you want
decisions.reason: Readable says what a willing spirit is (m2).

source.text: אֲלַמְּדָ֣ה פֹשְׁעִ֣ים דְּרָכֶ֑יךָ וְ֝חַטָּאִ֗ים אֵלֶ֥יךָ יָשֽׁוּבוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: I will teach transgressors your ways, and sinners to you will return.

en.L: I will teach those who transgress {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} ways, \q and sinners will turn back to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: I will teach rebels {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} paths, \q and sinners will come home to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: Then I will teach other people who have turned against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} how {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} want them to live. \q And sinners will come back to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: J’enseignerai à ceux qui transgressent {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} chemins, \q et les pécheurs reviendront à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.B: J’enseignerai {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} chemins aux rebelles, \q et les pécheurs reviendront vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: Alors j’apprendrai à ceux qui se sont tournés contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} comment {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} veux qu’ils vivent. \q Et les pécheurs reviendront vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Nitawafundisha waasi njia {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, \q nao wenye dhambi watageuka kurudi {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}.
sw.B: Nitawafundisha waasi mapito {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, \q na wenye dhambi watarudi nyumbani {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}.
sw.R: Ndipo nitakapowafundisha watu wengine waliokuasi jinsi {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unavyotaka waishi. \q Na wenye dhambi watarudi {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}.

es.L: Enseñaré a los transgresores {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} caminos, \q y los pecadores se volverán a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.B: Enseñaré {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} sendas a los rebeldes, \q y los pecadores regresarán a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.R: Entonces enseñaré a otros que se han puesto en contra de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} cómo quieres que vivan. \q Y los pecadores volverán a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

vi.L: Tôi sẽ dạy những kẻ vi phạm các đường lối của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và những kẻ tội lỗi sẽ quay về với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Tôi sẽ dạy những kẻ phản nghịch biết các nẻo đường của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và những kẻ tội lỗi sẽ trở về nhà với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Rồi tôi sẽ dạy những người khác đã chống lại {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn họ sống thế nào. \q Và những kẻ có tội sẽ trở lại với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 제가 반역하는 자들에게 주님의 길들을 가르치겠으니, \q 죄인들이 주님께로 돌아올 것입니다.
ko.B: 제가 거역하는 자들에게 주님의 길을 가르치면, \q 죄인들이 주님께로 돌아올 것입니다.
ko.R: 그러면 저는 주님을 거역한 다른 사람들에게 주님께서 원하시는 삶을 가르치겠습니다. \q 그러면 죄인들이 주님께 돌아올 것입니다.

pt.L: Ensinarei aos que transgridem os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} caminhos, \q e pecadores voltarão para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.B: Vou ensinar aos rebeldes os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} caminhos, \q e os pecadores voltarão para junto de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.R: Então vou ensinar outras pessoas que se viraram contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} a viver como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} queres. \q E os pecadores vão voltar para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

decisions.choice: I will teach: a resolve
decisions.reason: The verb has the form that expresses resolve. Restored, David will pass on what he has learned of God's mercy.

decisions.choice: return: turn back to God, repent
decisions.reason: The verb (shuv) is the word for coming back to God after going astray (Hosea 14).

decisions.choice: your ways: how God acts and how he wants people to live
decisions.reason: God's ways are both his mercy toward sinners and the paths he sets for them (25:4, 8-9).

decisions.choice: Then
decisions.reason: Readable makes the link with verses 12-14 plain: the teaching follows the restoring.

decisions.choice: how you want them to live
decisions.reason: Readable says what the ways are (m3).

source.text: הַצִּ֘ילֵ֤נִי מִדָּמִ֨ים׀אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים אֱלֹהֵ֥י תְּשׁוּעָתִ֑י תְּרַנֵּ֥ן לְ֝שׁוֹנִ֗י צִדְקָתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Deliver me from bloods, God, God of my salvation; will shout for joy my tongue [of] your righteousness.

en.L: Rescue me from bloodshed, God, God of my salvation; \q my tongue will shout for joy [at] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} righteousness.
en.B: Rescue me, God, from the guilt of the blood I have shed, \q God who saves me; \q then my tongue will ring out with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} righteousness.
en.R: God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are the God who saves me. \q Do not hold me guilty for the death I caused. \q Then I will sing with joy about how right {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are.

fr.L: Délivre-moi du sang versé, Dieu, Dieu de mon salut ; \q ma langue criera de joie [devant] {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} justice.
fr.B: Délivre-moi, Dieu, de la culpabilité du sang que j’ai versé, \q Dieu qui me sauves ; \q alors ma langue chantera {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} justice.
fr.R: Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es le Dieu qui me sauve. \q Ne me tiens pas pour coupable de la mort que j’ai causée. \q Alors je chanterai avec joie combien {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es juste.

sw.L: Uniokoe na damu, Ee Mungu, Mungu wa wokovu wangu; \q ulimi wangu utashangilia [kwa] haki {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Ee Mungu, uniokoe na hatia ya damu niliyoimwaga, \q {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} Mungu unayeniokoa; \q ndipo ulimi wangu utakapoimba kwa sauti haki {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Ee Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiwe Mungu anayeniokoa. \q Usinihesabie hatia kwa kifo nilichosababisha. \q Ndipo nitakapoimba kwa furaha jinsi {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulivyo wa haki.

es.L: Líbrame de la sangre derramada, oh Dios, Dios de mi salvación; \q mi lengua cantará con júbilo {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} justicia.
es.B: Líbrame, oh Dios, de la culpa de la sangre que he derramado, \q Dios que me salvas; \q entonces mi lengua proclamará a gritos {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} justicia.
es.R: Dios, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres el Dios que me salva. \q No me tengas por culpable de la muerte que causé. \q Entonces cantaré con alegría lo justo que eres.

vi.L: Xin giải cứu tôi khỏi [tội] đổ máu, lạy Đức Chúa Trời, Đức Chúa Trời của sự cứu rỗi tôi; \q lưỡi tôi sẽ reo hò [vì] sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin giải cứu tôi khỏi tội làm đổ máu người, \q Đức Chúa Trời là Đấng cứu rỗi tôi; \q khi ấy lưỡi tôi sẽ vang lên ca ngợi sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đức Chúa Trời cứu tôi. \q Xin đừng kể tôi có tội vì cái chết tôi đã gây ra. \q Khi ấy tôi sẽ vui mừng ca hát về sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 피에서 저를 건져 주십시오, 하나님, 제 구원의 하나님. \q 제 혀가 주님의 의를 기뻐 외칠 것입니다.
ko.B: 하나님, 제가 흘린 피의 죄에서 저를 건져 주십시오. \q 저를 구원하시는 하나님, \q 그러면 제 혀가 주님의 의를 소리 높여 노래할 것입니다.
ko.R: 하나님, 주님은 저를 구원하시는 하나님이십니다. \q 제가 사람을 죽게 한 죄를 묻지 말아 주십시오. \q 그러면 주님께서 얼마나 의로우신지 기쁘게 노래하겠습니다.

pt.L: Livra-me de sangue derramado, ó Deus, Deus da minha salvação; \q a minha língua gritará de alegria [pela] {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} justiça.
pt.B: Livra-me, ó Deus, da culpa do sangue que derramei, \q ó Deus que me salvas; \q então a minha língua celebrará em voz alta a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} justiça.
pt.R: Ó Deus, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és o Deus que me salva. \q Não me consideres culpado pela morte que causei. \q Então vou cantar com alegria sobre como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és justo.

decisions.choice: bloods: the guilt of shedding blood
decisions.reason: The plural "bloods" (damim) means blood that has been shed and the guilt it brings (Deuteronomy 19:10). David had Uriah killed (2 Samuel 11:14-17). Some take it as a plea to be saved from death, the penalty for murder.

decisions.choice: your righteousness: God's faithfulness in doing right and saving
decisions.reason: God's righteousness (tsedaqah) is his doing what is right, which in the Psalms includes rescuing those who turn to him (31:2; 71:2).

decisions.choice: will shout for joy: what follows the rescue
decisions.reason: The second line says what will happen once God answers.

decisions.choice: the death I caused
decisions.reason: Readable names what the bloodshed was (m1).

decisions.choice: how right you are
decisions.reason: Readable puts the noun as a clause (m2).

decisions.choice: then
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable mark that the praise follows the rescue (m3).

decisions.choice: la culpa de la sangre que he derramado (B); la muerte que causé (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "bloods", which here means the guilt of shedding blood; Balanced and Readable say so, as the English does. Literal says "la sangre derramada".

decisions.choice: Balanced and Readable put the line "저를 구원하시는 하나님" on its own, as the English does, and Readable puts it first
decisions.reason: Korean keeps the address "God who saves me" as its own line so the verse keeps the English level's three lines without splitting a phrase.

source.text: אֲ֭דֹנָי שְׂפָתַ֣י תִּפְתָּ֑ח וּ֝פִ֗י יַגִּ֥יד תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Lord, my lips you will open, and my mouth will declare your praise.

en.L: My Lord, open my lips, \q and my mouth will make known {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} praise.
en.B: Lord, open my lips to speak, \q and I will make {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} praise known.
en.R: Lord, open my lips so I can speak, \q and I will praise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} out loud.

fr.L: Mon Seigneur, ouvre mes lèvres, \q et ma bouche proclamera {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} louange.
fr.B: Seigneur, ouvre mes lèvres pour que je parle, \q et je ferai connaître {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} louange.
fr.R: Seigneur, ouvre mes lèvres pour que je puisse parler, \q et je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louerai à voix haute.

sw.L: Bwana wangu, ifungue midomo yangu, \q na kinywa changu kitatangaza sifa {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Ee Bwana, fungua midomo yangu niseme, \q nami nitazitangaza sifa {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.R: Bwana, fungua midomo yangu ili niweze kusema, \q nami nitakusifu kwa sauti.

es.L: Señor mío, abre mis labios, \q y mi boca dará a conocer {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} alabanza.
es.B: Señor, abre mis labios para hablar, \q y haré conocer {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} alabanza.
es.R: Señor, abre mis labios para que pueda hablar, \q y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} alabaré en voz alta.

vi.L: Lạy Chúa tôi, xin mở môi tôi, \q và miệng tôi sẽ rao truyền sự ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy Chúa, xin mở môi tôi để nói, \q và tôi sẽ rao truyền lời ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy Chúa, xin mở môi tôi để tôi có thể nói, \q và tôi sẽ lớn tiếng ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 주님, 제 입술을 열어 주십시오. \q 그러면 제 입이 주님을 찬양함을 알릴 것입니다.
ko.B: 주님, 제 입술을 열어 말하게 해 주십시오. \q 제가 주님을 찬양하는 노래를 널리 전하겠습니다.
ko.R: 주님, 제가 말할 수 있도록 제 입술을 열어 주십시오. \q 제가 소리 높여 주님을 찬양하겠습니다.

pt.L: Meu Senhor, abre os meus lábios, \q e a minha boca anunciará o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} louvor.
pt.B: Senhor, abre os meus lábios para que eu fale, \q e eu anunciarei o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} louvor.
pt.R: Senhor, abre os meus lábios para que eu possa falar, \q e eu vou {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louvar em voz alta.

decisions.choice: Lord: 'Adonai
decisions.reason: The title 'Adonai means "my Lord", master; it is not the divine name.

decisions.choice: open my lips: let me speak again
decisions.reason: Guilt had shut David's mouth (32:3). Only God's forgiveness can open it, and then it will praise him. The line is a request, though the verb is in the unfinished form.

decisions.choice: Lord
decisions.reason: In address, "Lord" carries the sense of "my Lord" ('Adonai); Literal keeps "my".

decisions.choice: I will make known (B); I will praise (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "I" for "my mouth".

decisions.choice: "Mon Seigneur" at Literal, "Seigneur" at Balanced and Readable, for Adonai
decisions.reason: Adonai means "my Lord"; in address French says "Seigneur", and Literal keeps the possessive, as the English does. It is not the divine name, so it is not in capitals.

decisions.choice: "Chúa" (not in capitals) for Adonai
decisions.reason: The word here is Adonai, "Lord" (see the meaning decision), not the divine name; the style guide writes it "Chúa", keeping capitals for YHWH.

decisions.choice: "주님" for Adonai (Lord), with no divine_name span
decisions.reason: As the style guide (section 7a): Adonai is 주님; only YHWH takes the divine_name setting.

source.text: כִּ֤י׀לֹא־תַחְפֹּ֣ץ זֶ֣בַח וְאֶתֵּ֑נָה ע֝וֹלָ֗ה לֹ֣א תִרְצֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For not you desire sacrifice, and I would give [it]; burnt offering not you accept.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do not take pleasure in sacrifice, or I would give [it]; \q burnt offering {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do not accept.
en.B: Sacrifice is not what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} desire, or I would offer it; \q a burnt offering does not please {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: Animal sacrifices are not what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} want, or I would bring them. \q Burnt offerings do not please {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne prends pas plaisir au sacrifice, sinon je [le] donnerais ; \q l’holocauste, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne l’agrées pas.
fr.B: Ce n’est pas un sacrifice que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} désires, sinon je l’offrirais ; \q un holocauste ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaît pas.
fr.R: Ce ne sont pas des sacrifices d’animaux que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} veux, sinon je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en apporterais. \q Les holocaustes ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaisent pas.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} hupendezwi na dhabihu, ama ningeitoa; \q sadaka ya kuteketezwa {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} huipokei.
sw.B: Si dhabihu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unayoitaka, la sivyo ningeitoa; \q sadaka ya kuteketezwa haikupendezi.
sw.R: Dhabihu za wanyama si kile {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unachotaka, la sivyo ningezileta. \q Sadaka za kuteketezwa hazikupendezi.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no deseas sacrificio, o yo [lo] daría; \q holocausto no aceptas.
es.B: El sacrificio no es lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} deseas, o yo lo ofrecería; \q un holocausto no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} agrada.
es.R: Los sacrificios de animales no son lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} quieres, o yo los traería. \q Los holocaustos no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} agradan.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không vui thích của lễ, bằng không tôi đã dâng [nó]; \q của lễ thiêu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không nhận.
vi.B: Của lễ không phải là điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn, nếu không tôi đã dâng rồi; \q của lễ thiêu cũng chẳng làm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hài lòng.
vi.R: Ngài không muốn của lễ bằng thú vật, nếu không tôi đã mang đến rồi. \q Của lễ thiêu không làm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vui lòng.

ko.L: 주님께서는 제사를 기뻐하지 않으시니, [그렇지 않다면] 제가 [그것을] 드렸을 것입니다. \q 번제물을 주님께서는 받지 않으십니다.
ko.B: 주님께서 원하시는 것이 제사라면 제가 드렸을 것입니다. \q 그러나 주님께서는 번제물을 기뻐하지 않으십니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 원하시는 것이 짐승을 바치는 제사라면, 제가 바쳤을 것입니다. \q 그러나 번제물은 주님을 기쁘게 하지 못합니다.

pt.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} não tens prazer em sacrifício, senão eu [o] daria; \q holocausto {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} não aceitas.
pt.B: Não é sacrifício o que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} desejas, senão eu o ofereceria; \q um holocausto não {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} agrada.
pt.R: Sacrifícios de animais não são o que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} queres, senão eu os traria. \q Holocaustos não {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} agradam.

decisions.choice: you do not desire sacrifice: no offering can pay for this sin
decisions.reason: The Law gave no sacrifice for sin done deliberately, like adultery and murder (Numbers 15:30-31). The psalm does not reject the offerings God commanded (verse 21) but says that they please God only from a broken heart (verse 19; 40:7; 1 Samuel 15:22).

decisions.choice: burnt offering: an animal burned whole on the altar
decisions.reason: In the burnt offering ('olah) the whole animal was burned, given entirely to God (Leviticus 1).

decisions.choice: accept: receive with favor
decisions.reason: The verb (ratsah) is used of God accepting an offering and the person who brings it (Leviticus 1:4).

decisions.choice: Animal sacrifices
decisions.reason: Readable says what was sacrificed.

source.text: זִֽבְחֵ֣י אֱלֹהִים֮ ר֪וּחַ נִשְׁבָּ֫רָ֥ה לֵב־נִשְׁבָּ֥ר וְנִדְכֶּ֑ה אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לֹ֣א תִבְזֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] sacrifices of God [are] a spirit broken; a heart broken and crushed, God, not you will despise.

en.L: The sacrifices of God [are] a broken spirit; \q a broken and crushed heart, \q God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will not despise.
en.B: The sacrifices that God accepts are a broken spirit. \q A heart that is broken and crushed, \q God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will never reject.
en.R: The sacrifice God really wants is a humble spirit, \q a person who is truly sorry. \q God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will not turn away anyone whose heart is broken and crushed by sorrow for sin.

fr.L: Les sacrifices de Dieu, [c’est] un esprit brisé ; \q un cœur brisé et broyé, \q Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne le mépriseras pas.
fr.B: Les sacrifices que Dieu accepte, c’est un esprit brisé. \q Un cœur brisé et broyé, \q Dieu, jamais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne le rejetteras.
fr.R: Le sacrifice que Dieu veut vraiment, c’est un esprit humble, \q quelqu’un qui regrette sincèrement. \q Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne repousseras personne dont le cœur est brisé et écrasé par le regret de son péché.

sw.L: Dhabihu za Mungu [ni] roho iliyovunjwa; \q moyo uliovunjwa na kupondwa, \q Ee Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} hutaupuuza.
sw.B: Dhabihu ambazo Mungu anazikubali ni roho iliyopondeka. \q Moyo uliovunjika na kupondwa, \q Ee Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} hutaukataa kamwe.
sw.R: Dhabihu ambayo Mungu anaitaka kweli ni roho ya unyenyekevu, \q mtu anayejuta kwa kweli. \q Ee Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} hutamkataa mtu yeyote ambaye moyo wake umevunjika na kupondeka kwa huzuni ya dhambi.

es.L: Los sacrificios para Dios [son] un espíritu roto; \q un corazón roto y triturado, \q oh Dios, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no despreciarás.
es.B: Los sacrificios que Dios acepta son un espíritu quebrantado. \q Un corazón roto y deshecho, \q oh Dios, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} nunca lo rechazarás.
es.R: El sacrificio que Dios de verdad quiere es un espíritu humilde, \q una persona que de verdad lamenta lo que hizo. \q Dios, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no rechazarás a nadie que tenga el corazón roto y deshecho por el dolor de su pecado.

vi.L: Các của lễ của Đức Chúa Trời [là] một tâm linh tan vỡ; \q một tấm lòng tan vỡ và giập nát, \q lạy Đức Chúa Trời, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không khinh dể.
vi.B: Của lễ Đức Chúa Trời chấp nhận là một tâm linh tan vỡ. \q Một tấm lòng tan vỡ và giập nát, \q lạy Đức Chúa Trời, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không bao giờ từ bỏ.
vi.R: Của lễ mà Đức Chúa Trời thật sự muốn là một tâm linh khiêm nhường, \q một người thật lòng ăn năn. \q Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không xua đuổi ai có tấm lòng tan vỡ và đau đớn vì tội lỗi mình.

ko.L: 하나님의 제사들은 부서진 영[입니다]. \q 부서지고 짓눌린 마음을, \q 하나님, 주님께서는 업신여기지 않으실 것입니다.
ko.B: 하나님께서 받으시는 제사는 꺾인 영입니다. \q 꺾이고 짓눌린 마음을 \q 하나님, 주님께서는 결코 물리치지 않으십니다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 정말 원하시는 제사는 겸손한 영, \q 진심으로 뉘우치는 사람입니다. \q 하나님, 주님께서는 죄를 슬퍼하여 마음이 무너지고 짓눌린 사람을 외면하지 않으십니다.

pt.L: Os sacrifícios de Deus [são] um espírito quebrantado; \q um coração quebrantado e esmagado, \q ó Deus, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} não desprezarás.
pt.B: Os sacrifícios que Deus aceita são um espírito quebrantado. \q Um coração quebrantado e esmagado, \q ó Deus, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nunca rejeitarás.
pt.R: O sacrifício que Deus quer de verdade é um espírito humilde, \q uma pessoa que está arrependida de verdade. \q Ó Deus, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} não vais rejeitar ninguém que tenha o coração partido e esmagado pela tristeza por causa do pecado.

decisions.choice: the sacrifices of God: the sacrifices God accepts
alternatives: my sacrifice, God, is (with other vowels)
decisions.reason: "Of God" means the sacrifices that God wants and receives. With different vowels and no change to the letters, the words could read "my sacrifice, God, is a broken spirit"; the text as it is read makes good sense.

decisions.choice: broken, crushed: humbled in repentance
decisions.reason: A broken spirit and a crushed heart belong to someone humbled by their sin and sorry for it (34:19; Isaiah 57:15). "Crushed" is the verb of verse 10: the one God has crushed he does not throw away.

decisions.choice: despise: look down on, reject
decisions.reason: The verb (bazah) means to treat as worthless.

decisions.choice: a humble spirit, a person who is truly sorry
decisions.reason: Readable says what a broken spirit is (m2).

decisions.choice: by sorrow for sin
decisions.reason: Readable says what has broken and crushed the heart (m2).

decisions.choice: esmagado
decisions.reason: "Crushed" is the verb of verse 10 (m2), where Portuguese says "os ossos que tu esmagaste"; "esmagado" keeps the link: the one God has crushed he does not throw away. "Contrito", the traditional word, loses it.

source.text: הֵיטִ֣יבָה בִ֭רְצוֹנְךָ אֶת־צִיּ֑וֹן תִּ֝בְנֶ֗ה חוֹמ֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Do good in your favor to Zion; may you build [the] walls of Jerusalem.

en.L: Do good in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} favor to Zion; \q build the walls of Jerusalem.
en.B: In {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} goodwill be kind to Zion, \q and raise up Jerusalem's walls.
en.R: Be good to Zion, as {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} love to do. \q Build the walls of Jerusalem strong.

fr.L: Fais du bien dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} faveur à Sion ; \q bâtis les murs de Jérusalem.
fr.B: Dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bienveillance, sois bon pour Sion, \q et relève les murs de Jérusalem.
fr.R: Sois bon pour Sion, comme {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} aimes le faire. \q Construis solidement les murs de Jérusalem.

sw.L: Kwa radhi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} utendee Sayuni wema; \q ujenge kuta za Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Kwa nia {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} njema uwe mwema kwa Sayuni, \q na uziinue kuta za Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Uwe mwema kwa Sayuni, kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unavyopenda kufanya. \q Jenga kuta za Yerusalemu ziwe imara.

es.L: Haz bien en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} benevolencia a Sion; \q edifica los muros de Jerusalén.
es.B: En {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} buena voluntad sé bondadoso con Sion, \q y levanta los muros de Jerusalén.
es.R: Sé bueno con Sion, como {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} encanta hacerlo. \q Construye fuertes los muros de Jerusalén.

vi.L: Xin làm điều tốt theo ý muốn tốt lành của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho Si-ôn; \q xin xây các tường thành Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Trong lòng ưu ái của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, xin đối xử tốt với Si-ôn, \q và dựng lại các tường thành Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Xin làm điều tốt cho Si-ôn, như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vẫn thích làm. \q Xin xây tường thành Giê-ru-sa-lem cho vững chắc.

ko.L: 주님의 은총으로 시온에 선을 베푸시고, \q 예루살렘의 성벽들을 쌓아 주십시오.
ko.B: 주님의 기쁘신 뜻대로 시온을 선대하시고, \q 예루살렘 성벽을 다시 세워 주십시오.
ko.R: 주님께서 좋아하시는 대로 시온에 좋은 일을 해 주십시오. \q 예루살렘 성벽을 튼튼하게 쌓아 주십시오.

pt.L: Faz bem, na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} benevolência, a Sião; \q constrói os muros de Jerusalém.
pt.B: Na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} boa vontade, sê bondoso com Sião \q e levanta as muralhas de Jerusalém.
pt.R: Sê bom para Sião, como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} gostas de ser. \q Faz fortes as muralhas de Jerusalém.

decisions.choice: Zion and Jerusalem: a prayer for the city
alternatives: a later addition for the people's worship
decisions.reason: The last two verses turn from David's own sin to the city. David may be praying for the city whose king he is, since his sin could bring harm on his people. Or the lines may have been added when the psalm was sung by the people, at a time when Jerusalem's walls were in ruins (Nehemiah 1:3).

decisions.choice: your favor: your goodwill, what pleases you
decisions.reason: The word (ratson) is God's favor and pleasure; it comes from the verb "accept" in verse 18.

decisions.choice: build: build up, make strong
decisions.reason: The verb (banah) is used both of building and of rebuilding what is broken.

decisions.choice: as you love to do
decisions.reason: Readable puts God's favor as something God delights in (m2).

source.text: אָ֤ז תַּחְפֹּ֣ץ זִבְחֵי־צֶ֭דֶק עוֹלָ֣ה וְכָלִ֑יל אָ֤ז יַעֲל֖וּ עַל־מִזְבַּחֲךָ֣ פָרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Then you will delight [in] sacrifices of righteousness, burnt offering and whole offering; then they will offer up on your altar bulls.

en.L: Then {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will delight [in] sacrifices of righteousness, burnt offering and whole offering; \q then they will offer up bulls on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} altar.
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will welcome sacrifices offered in righteousness, burnt offerings and whole offerings; \q then young bulls will be brought up onto {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} altar.
en.R: Then {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will be glad to accept the right kind of sacrifices, offerings burned whole on the altar. \q Then people will offer bulls on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} altar.

fr.L: Alors {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} prendras plaisir [aux] sacrifices de justice, holocauste et offrande entière ; \q alors on offrira des taureaux sur {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} autel.
fr.B: Alors {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} accueilleras les sacrifices offerts avec justice, holocaustes et offrandes entières ; \q alors on fera monter de jeunes taureaux sur {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} autel.
fr.R: Alors {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} seras heureux d’accepter les bons sacrifices, les offrandes brûlées entièrement sur l’autel. \q Alors on offrira des taureaux sur {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} autel.

sw.L: Hapo {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} utafurahia dhabihu za haki, sadaka ya kuteketezwa na sadaka kamili; \q hapo watapandisha mafahali juu ya madhabahu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Hapo {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} utazikaribisha dhabihu zinazotolewa kwa haki, sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka kamili; \q hapo ndama dume watapandishwa juu ya madhabahu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Hapo {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} utafurahi kupokea dhabihu zilizo sahihi, sadaka zinazoteketezwa nzima juu ya madhabahu. \q Ndipo watu watatoa mafahali juu ya madhabahu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

es.L: Entonces {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} deleitarás [en] sacrificios de justicia, holocausto y ofrenda entera; \q entonces ofrecerán becerros sobre {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} altar.
es.B: Entonces aceptarás con agrado sacrificios ofrecidos con justicia, holocaustos y ofrendas enteras; \q entonces subirán novillos sobre {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} altar.
es.R: Entonces {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} alegrará aceptar la clase correcta de sacrificios, ofrendas quemadas enteras sobre el altar. \q Entonces la gente ofrecerá toros sobre {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} altar.

vi.L: Khi ấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ vui thích [trong] các của lễ công chính, của lễ thiêu và của lễ thiêu trọn; \q khi ấy người ta sẽ dâng các bò đực trên bàn thờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Khi ấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ đón nhận các của lễ dâng trong sự công chính, của lễ thiêu và của lễ thiêu trọn vẹn; \q khi ấy những bò tơ sẽ được dâng lên bàn thờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Khi ấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ vui lòng nhận những của lễ đúng đắn, là những của lễ thiêu trọn trên bàn thờ. \q Khi ấy người ta sẽ dâng bò trên bàn thờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그때에 주님께서 의의 제사들, 번제와 온전한 제물을 기뻐하실 것입니다. \q 그때에 그들이 주님의 제단 위에 수소들을 바칠 것입니다.
ko.B: 그때에 주님께서는 의로 드리는 제사와 번제와 온전한 번제를 기꺼이 받으실 것이요, \q 그때에 사람들이 주님의 제단에 수송아지를 바칠 것입니다.
ko.R: 그때에는 주님께서 바른 제사, 곧 제단 위에서 통째로 태워 드리는 제물을 기쁘게 받으실 것입니다. \q 그때에 사람들이 주님의 제단에 수소를 바칠 것입니다.

pt.L: Então {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} terás prazer [em] sacrifícios de justiça, holocausto e oferta inteira; \q então oferecerão novilhos sobre o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} altar.
pt.B: Então {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} acolherás os sacrifícios oferecidos com justiça, holocaustos e ofertas inteiras; \q então novilhos serão levados ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} altar.
pt.R: Então {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} vais aceitar com alegria os sacrifícios certos, ofertas queimadas inteiras no altar. \q Então as pessoas vão oferecer touros no {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} altar.

decisions.choice: sacrifices of righteousness: right sacrifices
decisions.reason: Sacrifices offered as God commands and from a right heart (4:6; Deuteronomy 33:19). With a broken spirit (verse 19), the offerings God refused in verse 18 now please him.

decisions.choice: burnt offering and whole offering
decisions.reason: Both are offerings burned entirely on the altar ('olah, kalil; Deuteronomy 33:10; 1 Samuel 7:9). Young bulls were the costliest animals offered.

decisions.choice: they will offer up: people will offer
decisions.reason: The subject is not named: the worshipers in general.

decisions.choice: the right kind of sacrifices
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of the phrase (m1).
